# Instantly
> Instantly is an all-in-one sales engagement and lead intelligence platform combining automated outreach, email deliverability tools, a 450M+ B2B lead database, AI-powered automation, and CRM helping teams find, contact, and close their ideal clients faster.
Instantly helps sales teams, agencies, founders, and marketers scale cold email outreach with unlimited email accounts, built-in warmup, AI-powered personalization, and comprehensive deliverability tools. The platform is designed for modern outbound teams who want to reach primary inboxes, automate follow-ups, and convert leads into customers efficiently.
The platform's core value proposition centers on three pillars: (1) unlimited sending infrastructure with flat-fee pricing that scales for agencies, (2) a private deliverability network of 4.2M+ accounts ensuring emails land in primary inboxes, and (3) tight integration between lead data, outreach, inbox management, and AI agents in a single workflow.
---
## Company Information
### Corporate Details
- **Legal Entity**: Foo Monk LLC
- **Incorporation**: Wyoming, USA
- **Principal Address**: 30 N. Gould St., Sheridan, WY 82801
- **OpenCorporates Record**: [us_wy/2019-000862268](https://opencorporates.com/companies/us_wy/2019-000862268)
### Founding & Leadership
- **Founded**: 2021
- **Origin Story**: Co-founders built Instantly as an internal solution while running agencies and sales operations, later launching publicly (including an early AppSumo push that helped bootstrap growth)
- **Founders**:
 - Raul Kaevand (Co-founder & Co-CEO)
 - Nils Schneider (Co-founder & Co-CEO)
 - Reio Suun (Co-founder)
 - Sumit Kumar (Co-founder & CTO)
### Founder Background & Origin Story
Raul Kaevand and Nils Schneider met on the Reddit r/cofounder subreddit. They initially collaborated on a travel app that failed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. This experience led them to pivot to building a SaaS focused on automating cold outreach, born from pain points Raul experienced while scaling his lead generation agency (which generated $30K-$50K per month). The agency's own clients became Instantly's first 20 users. When usage spiked and results became undeniable, the team shut down the profitable agency to double down on SaaS.
### Company Culture & Operations
- **Team Size**: 50+ employees (estimate; remote team)
- **Operating Model**: Fully remote, global team
- **Management Philosophy**: "No managers" flat organizational structure
- **Customer Base**: 40,000+ clients (per careers page); 35,000+ customers (per G2 marketing)
### Funding & Financials
- **Funding Status**: Bootstrapped (no institutional funding rounds listed)
- **Revenue Milestones**:
 - October 2022: $2.4M ARR (9 months after launch)
 - December 2024: $20M+ ARR (third-party estimates; Instantly does not publish audited financials)
- **Go-to-Market**: Free trial model, self-serve + sales-assisted, affiliate program (up to 40% recurring commission)
- **Notable Growth**: Reached $200K MRR in just 6 months after launch; grew from 22 to 2,900+ customers rapidly
### Company Links
- [About Instantly](https://instantly.ai/about)
- [Careers](https://instantly.ai/careers)
- [Status Page](https://instantlyai.instatus.com)

## Platform Architecture & Core Concepts
### How Instantly Works
Instantly operates as an integrated outbound sales platform with four interconnected modules:
1. **Lead Discovery**: SuperSearch provides access to 450M+ B2B contacts with waterfall enrichment from 5+ data providers, allowing users to build targeted prospect lists based on firmographic, technographic, and intent signals.
2. **Outreach Automation**: The sending infrastructure supports unlimited email accounts with automatic sender rotation, warmup, and deliverability optimization. Campaigns can include multi-step sequences with A/Z variant testing.
3. **Deliverability Management**: A private network of 4.2M+ accounts powers email warmup, while Inbox Placement testing monitors where emails land. SISR (Server & IP Sharding & Rotation) provides dedicated IP pools for high-volume senders.
4. **Response Handling**: Unibox centralizes all replies across accounts, while AI Reply Agent can automatically handle responses in under 5 minutes. The CRM tracks opportunities through the pipeline with calling and SMS capabilities.
### Key Architectural Differentiators
- **Unlimited Accounts**: Unlike per-seat or per-account pricing models, Instantly charges flat fees with unlimited email account connections
- **Private Deliverability Network**: 4.2M+ accounts in a closed network for warmup and engagement signals
- **Integrated Data + Outreach**: Lead database and sending platform in one tool eliminates data export/import friction
- **SISR Technology**: Server & IP Sharding & Rotation provides dedicated/private IP pools for enterprise senders on Light Speed plan
---
## Products & Features 
### 1. Outreach - Email Campaign Automation
The core sending platform for automated email sequences at scale.
**Primary Capabilities**:
- Unlimited email account connections (all plans)
- Unlimited warmup included on all plans
- Automatic sender rotation across accounts
- Multi-step email sequences with scheduling
- A/Z testing for subject lines, body copy, and CTAs
- Global block list to prevent sending to specified domains/addresses
- Reputation protection with automatic pause on delivery issues
- Bounce detection and automatic list cleaning
- Comprehensive analytics and reporting
- API access and webhook integrations
**AI-Powered Features** (Growth plan and above):
- AI Sequence Writer for generating email copy
- AI Rephrase tool for creating variants
- AI Spam Words Checker to identify deliverability risks
- Advanced warmup options: weekday-only sending, read emulation, configurable open rates, reply rates
**Advanced Deliverability** (Light Speed plan):
- SISR (Server & IP Sharding & Rotation)
- Dedicated/private server infrastructure
- Private IP pool allocation
- Enhanced sending reputation isolation
**Links**:
- [Outreach Product Page](https://instantly.ai)
- [Email Warmup](https://instantly.ai/email-warmup)
- [Inbox Placement](https://instantly.ai/inbox-placement)
- [Inbox Placement Documentation](https://help.instantly.ai/en/articles/10258482-inbox-placement-automated-tests)
---
### 2. SuperSearch - B2B Lead Database
Access to 450M+ B2B contacts with AI-powered enrichment and filtering.
**Database Specifications**:
- 450M+ verified B2B leads
- Waterfall enrichment from 5+ data providers
- Real-time verification on export
- Regular database updates and maintenance
**Search & Filtering Capabilities**:
- Firmographic filters: company size, revenue, industry, location
- Technographic filters: technologies used, tech stack signals
- Contact-level filters: job title, seniority, department, function
- Intent signals and buying indicators
- AI-powered natural language search (e.g., "Founders of SaaS companies in New York with 50-100 employees")
- Saved searches and alerts
**Enrichment Features**:
- LLM-assisted enrichment for custom data points
- AI templates for personalization variables
- Waterfall enrichment (tries multiple providers until data found)
- Email verification included
- Phone number enrichment (where available)
- AI web research agent that scrapes additional data from company websites
- Job listings enrichment that reveals active hiring patterns
- Technology scanning that identifies current software stacks
- News enrichment that surfaces recent media mentions for personalization
**Export & Integration**:
- Direct export to Instantly campaigns
- CSV/Excel export
- CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce)
- API access for programmatic queries
**Credits System**:
- Lead exports consume credits
- AI enrichment consumes credits (0.5 credits per contact)
- Credits refresh monthly based on plan
- Unused credits do not roll over (verify current policy)
- Verified work email found directly by Instantly: 1 credit
- Verified work email via partner provider: 2+ credits
- Average credit cost per verified email: ~1.5 credits
- Email verification for emails you already have: 0.25 credits
**Links**:
- [SuperSearch Product Page](https://instantly.ai/b2b-lead-finder)
- [AI Enrichment API](https://developer.instantly.ai/api/v2/supersearchenrichment/createaienrichment)
---
### 3. Email Warmup - Deliverability Network
Automated warmup system using a private network of 4.2M+ accounts.
**How It Works**:
1. Connect your email accounts to Instantly
2. Warmup system sends emails between your accounts and the 4.2M+ account network
3. Emails are automatically opened, read, and replied to
4. Positive engagement signals build sender reputation
5. System gradually increases sending volume over time
**Warmup Configuration Options**:
- Daily send volume limits (gradual ramp-up)
- Slow ramp-up mode for building sender reputation
- Weekday-only sending option
- Read emulation (simulates human reading patterns)
- Configurable open rates
- Configurable reply rates
- Custom warmup schedules
**Deliverability Monitoring**:
- Inbox placement tracking
- Spam folder detection
- Reputation scoring
- Real-time spam monitoring
- Automated alerts on deliverability drops
**Best Practices**:
- Warm up new domains for 2-4 weeks (ideally 30 days) before campaigns
- Maintain warmup even during active sending
- Use dedicated domains for cold outreach (not your primary domain)
- Monitor inbox placement scores regularly
- Cap sends at 20-30 emails per inbox per day
- Keep bounce rates at or below 1%
**Deliverability Targets**:
- Aim for 80%+ inbox placement
- Keep bounces ≤1-2%
- Keep Gmail spam complaints ≤0.3%
**Links**:
- [Email Warmup Product Page](https://instantly.ai/email-warmup)
- [Deliverability Network Details](https://instantly.ai/blog/instantly-vs-apollo-for-agencies-what-real-users-say-and-why/)
---
### 4. Inbox Placement Testing
Automated testing to verify emails land in primary inbox vs. spam/promotions.
**Testing Capabilities**:
- Automated inbox placement tests on schedule
- Tests across major providers (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, etc.)
- Primary inbox vs. promotions vs. spam categorization
- Detailed deliverability insights per provider
- Historical tracking and trend analysis
**Alert System**:
- Automated alerts when placement drops
- Threshold-based notifications
- Email and in-app alerts
- Slack integration for team notifications
**API Access**:
- Programmatic test triggering
- Results retrieval via API
- Webhook notifications on test completion
- Integration with CI/CD pipelines for automated monitoring
**Links**:
- [Inbox Placement Product Page](https://instantly.ai/inbox-placement)
- [Inbox Placement Documentation](https://help.instantly.ai/en/articles/10258482-inbox-placement-automated-tests)
- [Inbox Placement API](https://developer.instantly.ai/api/v2/inboxplacementtest)
---
### 5. CRM - Deal & Reply Management
Unified inbox and pipeline management with multi-channel capabilities.
**Unibox (Unified Inbox)**:
- Centralized view of all replies across all connected accounts
- Thread grouping and conversation history
- Lead status tracking and tagging
- Quick actions: reply, forward, snooze, archive
- Search and filtering across all conversations
- Team assignment and handoff
- AI Custom Reply Labels automatically categorize responses (Interested, Closed-Won, Not Interested, etc.)
**Pipeline Management**:
- Customizable deal stages
- Drag-and-drop pipeline interface
- Deal value tracking
- Win/loss analysis
- Stage duration analytics
- Forecasting (where available)
**Task Management**:
- Follow-up task creation
- Due date tracking
- Task assignment to team members
- Automated task creation from triggers
- Calendar integration
**Calling & SMS** (Hyper CRM):
- Built-in calling functionality
- SMS sending and tracking
- Call recording (where permitted)
- Click-to-call from contact records
- Call analytics and logging
**Salesflows** (Hyper CRM):
- Multi-channel sequence automation
- Trigger-based workflows
- Conditional branching
- Automated task creation
**Reporting**:
- Reply rates and response analytics
- Team performance metrics
- Pipeline velocity reports
- Revenue attribution
- Custom report building (Hyper CRM)
**Coming Soon Features** (as of last update):
- Priority AI
- Follow-up AI
**Links**:
- [CRM Product Page](https://instantly.ai/crm)
---
### 6. Website Visitors - Visitor Identification
Identify anonymous US website visitors and convert to leads.
**How It Works**:
1. Install tracking pixel on your website
2. System identifies US-based company visitors
3. Matches visitors to contact database
4. Enriches with email and company data
5. Pushes identified contacts to CRM or campaigns
**Capabilities**:
- US visitor identification (US focus due to data regulations)
- Company identification from IP/device signals
- Contact enrichment with emails
- Real-time Slack notifications
- Automatic CRM record creation
- Direct push to Instantly campaigns
- 1 credit per resolved visitor profile (business email and/or LinkedIn found)
- Company-only sightings on paid plans do not consume credits
**Use Cases**:
- Identify high-intent visitors to sales pages
- Retarget pricing page visitors
- Alert sales team to target account visits
- Build warm outreach lists from site traffic
**Limitations**:
- US visitors only (international identification limited)
- GDPR and PIPEDA compliant (does not collect data from EU or Canadian visitors)
- Identification rates vary by traffic quality
- B2B focus (consumer identification limited)
**Legal Compliance**:
- Requires cookie banner/consent mechanism
- Privacy policy must disclose pixel usage and data collection
- Must provide opt-out mechanism for visitors
- Subject to CCPA, CPRA requirements
- [Website Visitor Legal Compliance Guide](https://help.instantly.ai/en/articles/9503008-instantly-ai-website-visitor-id-legal-compliance-onboarding)
**Links**:
- [Website Visitors Product Page](https://instantly.ai/website-visitors)
---

Frequently Asked Questions
Can’t find the answer here? Check out our help center.
Go To Help Center
Can I really connect and warm up unlimited accounts with one subscription?
 
Yes! You can connect and warm as many accounts as you need from any provider.
I’ve never done email outreach before, will this work for me?
 
Absolutely, we’ve even prepared a full step-by-step tutorial on how we launch our campaigns.
What if I need to have more than 25,000 leads or send more than 100,000 emails?
 
You can upgrade your account to send as many emails as you need :).
Do you also provide leads I can send emails to?
 
Yes we do! You can use Instantly Lead Finder to find your ideal prospects.
Is Instantly completely automated?
 
After you’ve set up your campaigns - it runs completely on autopilot. All you need to do is make sure there’s enough leads in your campaigns and that’s it.
